title: validateApp requires owner; apps pass team from package.json (all in mono; shared-contracts is in-repo lib, no release/version needed)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. Assumptions: team values hardcoded since the inlining bundler can't import package.json; shared-contracts is an in-repo lib so no version bump; platform-kit untouched. PR #1 merged, CD green.
